record_title: Conjugations yield non-bicircular generalized bi-circular idempotents
limitations: The result disproves the stated dichotomy and Form IV conclusion in arXiv:2609.18967v1 but does not give a complete corrected classification. The elementary conjugation mechanism is not claimed to be historically new. The full text of the 2019 corrigendum was not inspected, so a closely related prior construction remains a bibliographic risk; that would not affect the counterexample to the current v1 statement.
